sentences.en: Oh, like, for example, there are no trash cans in Japan.
sentences.zh: 比如，在日本街头根本找不到垃圾桶。

sentences.en: They were removed after the subway gas bombing of 1995.
sentences.zh: 它们是在1995年地铁沙林毒气事件后被撤走的。

sentences.en: So, if you acquire any trash in your day, you have to carry it around until you get home.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你白天产生了任何垃圾，就得一直带着，直到回家为止。

sentences.en: Like, let's say you get a Starbucks.
sentences.zh: 比如，假设你买了杯星巴克。

sentences.en: First of all, no one walks around and eats or walks around and drinks in Japan.
sentences.zh: 首先，在日本没人会边走边吃或边走边喝。

sentences.en: You can get a food or drink item to go, but you have to just stand to the side and eat
sentences.zh: 你可以买外带的食物或饮料，但你必须站在路边把它吃完

sentences.en: or drink.
sentences.zh: 或喝完。

sentences.en: Also, no eating or drinking on the trains.
sentences.zh: 另外，在地铁上也不允许吃喝。

sentences.en: On the bullet train, it's okay, but not on the subway.
sentences.zh: 在新干线上可以，但在地铁里不行。

sentences.en: So, let's say you grab a hot can of coffee from 7-Eleven, because that's another thing.
sentences.zh: 所以，假设你从7-Eleven买了一罐热咖啡，因为这也是日本的一大特色。

sentences.en: The 7-Elevens have hot cans of coffee.
sentences.zh: 7-Eleven里有热咖啡罐装饮料。

sentences.en: There's 7-Elevens?
sentences.zh: 那里也有7-Eleven？

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 噢，有的。

sentences.en: Famously, 7-Elevens.
sentences.zh: 7-Eleven在日本非常出名。

sentences.en: Yeah, they're huge there.
sentences.zh: 是的，它们在那儿规模很大。

sentences.en: And they have all these snacks and sushi.
sentences.zh: 而且有各种零食和寿司。

sentences.en: Yeah, the 7-Eleven, is it egg salad, is supposed to be world-renowned.
sentences.zh: 没错，7-Eleven的鸡蛋沙拉三明治据说享誉全球。

sentences.en: Oh, that's right.
sentences.zh: 噢，对哦。

sentences.en: I remember hearing this.
sentences.zh: 我记得听过这个说法。

sentences.en: You guys, I didn't eat it.
sentences.zh: 伙计们，我居然没吃。

sentences.en: Can you believe it?
sentences.zh: 你们敢信吗？

sentences.en: Me, lover of eggs.
sentences.zh: 我，一个鸡蛋爱好者。

sentences.en: Every day, my son was like, Mom, are you going to get that egg salad sandwich today?
sentences.zh: 我儿子每天都问我：妈，你今天打算买那个鸡蛋沙拉三明治吗？

sentences.en: And every time, I was like, I just don't feel like eating eggs right now.
sentences.zh: 而我每次都说：我现在不太想吃鸡蛋。

sentences.en: It's always, like, full.
sentences.zh: 那货架总是满满当当的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: So, I can't believe I went all the way to Japan, and I didn't eat the egg salad sandwich.
sentences.zh: 所以我真不敢相信，我大老远跑去日本，竟然没吃那个鸡蛋沙拉三明治。

sentences.en: But anyway, okay, back to my journal.
sentences.zh: 不过话说回来，好吧，回到我的日记。

sentences.en: There's a whole section that looks like it's refrigerated and filled with cans, but actually,
sentences.zh: 店里有一整排看起来像冷藏柜的地方，摆满了罐装饮料，但实际上，

sentences.en: they are all hot.
sentences.zh: 它们全是热的。

sentences.en: So, let's say you get a hot can of coffee.
sentences.zh: 所以，假设你买了一罐热咖啡。

sentences.en: You stand and drink it.
sentences.zh: 你得站着把它喝完。

sentences.en: And when you're done, zero trash cans.
sentences.zh: 喝完之后，根本没垃圾桶。

sentences.en: You have to carry that can around.
sentences.zh: 你得一直带着那个空罐子。

sentences.en: You might be thinking, could I throw it away in a public restroom?
sentences.zh: 你可能会想，我能把它扔在公共厕所里吗？

sentences.en: Because I thought that.
sentences.zh: 因为我当时也这么想过。

sentences.en: I thought there might be a trash can in there.
sentences.zh: 我以为里面可能会有垃圾桶。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 并没有。

sentences.en: Most public restrooms didn't have paper towels or trash bins.
sentences.zh: 大多数公共厕所里既没有擦手纸，也没有垃圾桶。

sentences.en: They had hand dryers.
sentences.zh: 只有干手机。

sentences.en: And if they did have a trash bin, it is not considered polite to throw anything other
sentences.zh: 而且就算有垃圾桶，往里面扔除

sentences.en: than feminine products or paper towels in it.
sentences.zh: 女性卫生用品或擦手纸以外的东西，也是很不礼貌的。

sentences.en: So, you carry around your trash.
sentences.zh: 所以，你只能随身带着垃圾。

sentences.en: In a bag, in your purse, in your pocket.
sentences.zh: 放在包里、钱包里，或者口袋里。

sentences.en: I found it sort of fascinating because you really get a sense of how much trash you produce
sentences.zh: 我觉得这挺有意思的，因为当你被迫整天带着垃圾时，你真的会意识到自己到底制造了多少垃圾。

sentences.en: when you're forced to carry it around with you all day.
sentences.zh: 当你被迫整天带着垃圾时，你真的会意识到自己到底制造了多少垃圾。

sentences.en: And here's the other thing.
sentences.zh: 还有一件事。

sentences.en: The city is spotless.
sentences.zh: 这座城市一尘不染。

sentences.en: Everyone picks up after themselves.
sentences.zh: 每个人都会自觉清理自己的垃圾。

sentences.en: I was actually trying to imagine a Japanese person going to New York City and seeing the
sentences.zh: 我其实在试着想象一个日本人去纽约，用他们的视角去看那座城市，

sentences.en: city through their eyes, and I shuddered at the thought.
sentences.zh: 光是想想我就不寒而栗。

sentences.en: And listen, I love New York, but it's so dirty.
sentences.zh: 听着，我爱纽约，但它真的太脏了。

sentences.en: Okay, I should go.
sentences.zh: 好了，我该走了。

sentences.en: I'll write more later if I'm able.
sentences.zh: 如果可以的话，我之后再写。

sentences.en: Ah-ha!
sentences.zh: 啊哈！

sentences.en: You were talking to your journal.
sentences.zh: 你在跟你的日记说话。

sentences.en: I was.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It's your friend.
sentences.zh: 它是你的朋友。

sentences.en: Okay, I gotta go.
sentences.zh: 好了，我得走了。

sentences.en: I hope you guys realize both of these fit together like puzzle pieces.
sentences.zh: 希望你们意识到这两份记录就像拼图一样契合。

sentences.en: If you erase the places that you went, this could be the same story.
sentences.zh: 如果你抹掉去过的地方，这可能就是同一个故事。

sentences.en: Yours is all about how you got there with nothing about what you did when you were there.
sentences.zh: 你写的内容全是关于怎么到达那里的，完全没提你在那里做了什么。

sentences.en: I talk about it in hindsight, what I did in places.
sentences.zh: 我是在事后回顾时才提到我在那些地方做了什么。

sentences.en: True, but not to the extent of Jenna's.
sentences.zh: 确实，但没达到珍娜那种程度。

sentences.en: No, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不是的。

sentences.en: You didn't mention once how everyone's moods were.
sentences.zh: 你一次都没提到大家的情绪如何。

sentences.en: No, I didn't talk about other people.
sentences.zh: 没错，我没谈论其他人。

sentences.en: I didn't talk about my family dynamics.
sentences.zh: 我没谈论我的家庭动态。

sentences.en: You guys see that you fill in each other's stories like that.
sentences.zh: 你们看，你们就这样填补了彼此的故事。

sentences.en: Maybe this is why we're BFFs.
sentences.zh: 也许这就是我们成为死党的原因。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: This is why our points of view meld so well together into a podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们的观点能如此完美地融合进播客里。

sentences.en: We compliment each other.
sentences.zh: 我们互补。

sentences.en: We do.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: All.
sentences.zh: 全都有。

sentences.en: I have more.
sentences.zh: 我还有更多。

sentences.en: Please.
sentences.zh: 请讲。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I want you to read the entire thing.
sentences.zh: 我想让你把剩下的全读完。

sentences.en: Okay, here's the rest of it.
sentences.zh: 好的，这是剩下的部分。

sentences.en: Ready?
sentences.zh: 准备好了吗？

sentences.en: We love Tokyo.
sentences.zh: 我们爱东京。

sentences.en: We head to Kyoto tomorrow and we kind of wish we had another day here.
sentences.zh: 我们明天出发去京都，真希望在这里能多待一天。

sentences.en: Lee and I came years ago, just the two of us, and we liked it, but visiting it again,
sentences.zh: 李和我几年前来过，就我们俩，当时我们很喜欢这里，但这次重游，

sentences.en: we've fallen in love.
sentences.zh: 我们彻底爱上了它。

sentences.en: One of the things we are discovering is how vertical the city is.
sentences.zh: 我们发现的一件事是这座城市有多么立体。

sentences.en: You have to get off the ground level.
sentences.zh: 你必须离开地面。

sentences.en: The best stores and restaurants are up.
sentences.zh: 最好的商店和餐厅都在楼上。

sentences.en: The other night, we ate at a Wagyu barbecue place near Ueno Park, and one of the best parts
sentences.zh: 前几天晚上，我们在上野公园附近吃了一家和牛烧烤，这顿饭最棒的部分之一

sentences.en: of the meal was riding the elevator to the 11th floor.
sentences.zh: 就是坐电梯到11楼的过程。

sentences.en: We stopped at a bunch of floors along the way, and every time the doors opened, they opened
sentences.zh: 我们中途停了好几层，每次电梯门打开，

sentences.en: into a different restaurant.
sentences.zh: 看到的都是一家不同的餐厅。

sentences.en: Oh, cool.
sentences.zh: 哦，太酷了。

sentences.en: And you would get this tiny glimpse into a whole new world, a whole vibe with new smells
sentences.zh: 你会瞥见一个全新的世界，一种全新的氛围，伴随着新的气味

sentences.en: and sounds, and then the doors would shut and take you up to the next spot.
sentences.zh: 和声音，然后电梯门关上，带你继续上升到下一处。

sentences.en: I wanted to stop at every floor.
sentences.zh: 我真想在每一层都停下来看看。

sentences.en: One time, the doors opened on a giant fish tank.
sentences.zh: 有一次，电梯门一开，外面竟然是一个巨大的鱼缸。

sentences.en: That's all, just a fish tank.
sentences.zh: 就那样，只是一个鱼缸。

sentences.en: We are still all talking about it days later, and I keep thinking about it.
sentences.zh: 几天过去了，我们还在谈论这件事，我脑子里也一直挥之不去。

sentences.en: It was like riding in a real-life choose-your-own-adventure book, each stop having the potential to
sentences.zh: 那感觉就像置身于一本现实版的“选择你自己的冒险”书中，每一站都有可能

sentences.en: change your destiny.
sentences.zh: 改变你的命运。

sentences.en: Another highlight of the trip was going to the Tokyo Dome to see the Tokyo Giants play
sentences.zh: 这次旅行的另一个亮点是去东京巨蛋看东京读卖巨人队对阵

sentences.en: the Tigers.
sentences.zh: 阪神虎队的比赛。

sentences.en: I don't know where the Tigers were from, but I know it was the Giants versus the Tigers,
sentences.zh: 我不知道虎队是从哪来的，但我知道那是巨人队对阵虎队，

sentences.en: and this is a big rivalry.
sentences.zh: 这是一场宿敌之战。

sentences.en: We got to the game and bought some Giants hats, and we're all so excited, and then we realized
sentences.zh: 我们到了球场，买了些巨人队的帽子，大家都兴奋不已，结果后来才发现

sentences.en: we were sitting in the Tigers section.
sentences.zh: 我们坐在虎队的球迷区。

sentences.en: Oh, no!
sentences.zh: 噢，不！

sentences.en: So it was kind of hilarious, because they have dedicated sections for fans, and they have
sentences.zh: 这事儿挺逗的，因为他们有专门的球迷区，而且比赛期间

sentences.en: all these chants they do during the game.
sentences.zh: 他们会一直唱各种应援口号。

sentences.en: It reminded me of the chants at the LAFC soccer games.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起了洛杉矶FC足球赛上的那些口号。

sentences.en: Just constant chanting, but so fun.
sentences.zh: 就是不停地唱，但真的很有趣。

sentences.en: There is a small theme park surrounding the Dome.
sentences.zh: 巨蛋周围还有一个小型主题公园。

sentences.en: It is smaller than Six Flags or Disneyland, but they do have a log flume ride and one of
sentences.zh: 它比六旗或迪士尼乐园小，但确实有激流勇进和那种

sentences.en: those big swinging pirate ships, and it has one of the tallest, continuous roller coasters
sentences.zh: 大型海盗船，而且还有世界上最高的连续过山车之一，

sentences.en: in the world, currently ranked number 10.
sentences.zh: 目前排名第十。

sentences.en: Lee went on it with Harper.
sentences.zh: 李和哈珀一起去坐了。

sentences.en: Ooh, they loved it.
sentences.zh: 噢，他们玩得很开心。

sentences.en: They said the initial drop was insane.
sentences.zh: 他们说刚开始那个俯冲简直疯狂。

sentences.en: And of course, there was a place with a gazillion crane machines.
sentences.zh: 当然，那里还有个地方摆满了数不清的抓娃娃机。

sentences.en: We spent a lot of yen trying to win a plushie, but went home empty-handed.
sentences.zh: 我们花了不少日元想抓个毛绒玩具，结果空手而归。

sentences.en: Maybe the coolest thing we did in Tokyo was our Shibuya food tour.
sentences.zh: 我们在东京做过最酷的事情可能就是涩谷美食之旅了。

sentences.en: We had a local guide take us through the underground food stalls of the food show
sentences.zh: 我们请了一位当地向导，带我们逛了涩谷火车站下方

sentences.en: beneath Shibuya train station.
sentences.zh: 美食秀的地下美食摊位。

sentences.en: He explained that all of the food stalls were pop-up versions of some of the best restaurants
sentences.zh: 他解释说，所有的美食摊位都是东京顶级大厨经营的

sentences.en: from the best chefs in Tokyo.
sentences.zh: 一些最好的餐厅的快闪店。

sentences.en: There was a place selling bento boxes made by a three-star Michelin chef.
sentences.zh: 有一家店卖的是米其林三星大厨制作的便当盒。

sentences.en: Our first stop was a six-stool ramen place that had been voted best chicken ramen in Tokyo
sentences.zh: 我们的第一站是一家只有六个座位的小拉面店，它连续几年被评为

sentences.en: for several years in a row.
sentences.zh: 东京最好的鸡汤拉面。

sentences.en: You're making me so hungry.
sentences.zh: 你说的我都饿了。

sentences.en: Also, you're describing a place I've always wanted to go to.
sentences.zh: 而且，你描述的地方一直是我梦寐以求想去的地方。

sentences.en: I know exactly what you're referencing right now.
sentences.zh: 我完全知道你现在指的是哪里。

sentences.en: Um, Sam, it was amazing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，萨姆，那真的太棒了。

sentences.en: That's the next line in my journal.
sentences.zh: 那正是我日记里的下一行。

sentences.en: And it was amazing.
sentences.zh: 而且它确实很棒。

sentences.en: Sam, it was amazing.
sentences.zh: 萨姆，那真的太棒了。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊。

sentences.en: They served the ramen with a slice of lemon,
sentences.zh: 他们上拉面时会配一片柠檬，

sentences.en: and we were told to squeeze the lemon into the bowl about halfway through
sentences.zh: 并告诉我们在吃到一半的时候把柠檬挤进碗里，

sentences.en: as a way to change the flavor complexity of the broth.
sentences.zh: 以此来改变汤底风味的层次感。

sentences.en: Afterward, our guide walked us through the supermarket attached to the food stalls.
sentences.zh: 之后，向导带我们逛了美食摊位旁边的超市。

sentences.en: He showed us these fancy cantaloupes that cost around $70 or $80.
sentences.zh: 他给我们看了那些售价约七八十美元的高级哈密瓜。

sentences.en: Whoa!
sentences.zh: 哇！

sentences.en: He said the Japanese give fruit as a gift,
sentences.zh: 他说日本人会把水果当作礼物送人，

sentences.en: and the nicer-looking the fruit, the higher the price,
sentences.zh: 水果看起来越精致，价格就越贵，

sentences.en: even though they taste the same.
sentences.zh: 尽管吃起来味道都一样。

sentences.en: With the cantaloupe, the deeper the grooves, the more expensive.
sentences.zh: 对于哈密瓜，纹路越深，价格越贵。

sentences.en: He also said if someone is in the hospital, you give fruit or cut flowers,
sentences.zh: 他还说，如果有人住院，你要送水果或鲜切花，

sentences.en: but never planted flowers or anything with roots,
sentences.zh: 但千万别送盆栽或带根的植物，

sentences.en: because that implies you want them to put down roots in their illness.
sentences.zh: 因为那意味着你希望他们在那场病里扎根。

sentences.en: We ended with a trip to a teppanyaki restaurant.
sentences.zh: 我们最后去了一家铁板烧餐厅。

sentences.en: We were the only tourist there.
sentences.zh: 我们是那里唯一的游客。

sentences.en: No one spoke English, no English menu.
sentences.zh: 没人说英语，也没有英文菜单。

sentences.en: So it's a good thing we were with him.
sentences.zh: 所以幸好我们和他在一起。

sentences.en: I feel like we would have been too intimidated to go to this restaurant otherwise.
sentences.zh: 我觉得如果不是他，我们肯定不敢进这家餐厅。

sentences.en: He ordered all the food, and it was seriously all amazing.
sentences.zh: 他点了一桌菜，真的每一道都绝了。

sentences.en: My favorite were the meat-stuffed green peppers,
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的是青椒酿肉、

sentences.en: the fried ginger root, and the chicken thighs.
sentences.zh: 炸姜根和鸡腿肉。

sentences.en: We are so sad to leave Tokyo.
sentences.zh: 我们要离开东京了，好难过。

sentences.en: We wanted to ride more elevators and see what the doors opened onto.
sentences.zh: 我们还想多坐几次电梯，看看门后通向哪里。

sentences.en: I really wish I could have explored more of the Shibuya and the food market.
sentences.zh: 我真希望能多逛逛涩谷和那个美食市场。

sentences.en: I wanted to buy one of those bento boxes to eat on the train tomorrow,
sentences.zh: 我本来想买个便当盒明天在火车上吃，

sentences.en: but they made it very clear you had to eat it the same day.
sentences.zh: 但他们明确表示必须当天吃完。

sentences.en: Maybe one day.
sentences.zh: 也许以后有机会吧。

sentences.en: I am excited to get out into nature a bit,
sentences.zh: 我很期待能去大自然里走走，

sentences.en: and we have fun stuff planned for Kyoto.
sentences.zh: 而且我们在京都安排了一些有趣的活动。

sentences.en: We are going to make pottery with a local artist,
sentences.zh: 我们要和一位当地艺术家一起做陶艺，

sentences.en: and then he fires the pieces and sends them back home to us.
sentences.zh: 然后他会把作品烧制好寄回我们家。

sentences.en: I can't wait.
sentences.zh: 我等不及了。

sentences.en: This has already been an incredible trip,
sentences.zh: 这趟旅程已经非常不可思议了，

sentences.en: and we are making great memories.
sentences.zh: 我们正在创造美好的回忆。

sentences.en: Oh, I love that, lady.
sentences.zh: 噢，我喜欢这个，女士。

sentences.en: And guys, I have to tell you,
sentences.zh: 伙计们，我得告诉你们，

sentences.en: when it was time for us to fly home,
sentences.zh: 当我们准备飞回家的时候，

sentences.en: our flight was delayed by five hours,
sentences.zh: 航班延误了五个小时，

sentences.en: so we got to spend extra time in Tokyo.
sentences.zh: 所以我们又在东京多待了一会儿。

sentences.en: We went back to the Shibuya food show,
sentences.zh: 我们又回到了涩谷的美食展区，
